results.title: Esta no es tu casa
results.overview: An architecture student enters a vacated house of the typical "chorizo" style with the intention of documenting and mapping its layout. But as he moves down the central hallway, rooms begin to warp revealing an impossible structure, exits vanish, and every turn leads somewhere unknown. What was expected to be a routine assignment became instead a chilling piece of found footage captured on tape inside a labyrinth that seems to have no end.

results.title: Fire and the Thud
results.overview: A drunken man comes up with a permanent solution for taking care of a noisy, soul-sucking, gigantic modern-day nuisance.

results.title: Stud
results.overview: A woman and her dog hope to meet someone special on an afternoon walk in the forest.

results.title: Method
results.overview: After watching grief transform her classmate into a brilliant actor, an ambitious student wonders what she’s missing. "Method" is a darkly funny satire about jealousy, grief, and how far artists will go for authenticity.

results.title: Fruit & Nut
results.overview: The untold story of the most famous duo of all time.

results.title: Château d'If
results.overview: Day after day, a mysterious spectator obsessively plays the same VHS tape, in which DANTE and MERCEDES rest exhaustedly under a tree after a long journey, where they seal their vow of love. As the tape progressively deteriorates, Dante realizes that Mercedes begins to repeat her lines inconsistently until she freezes. Upon becoming aware that his reality is a world of fiction, Dante gradually descends into madness, threatening to take control of the viewer's real world.

results.title: Bite Size Terror
results.overview: A bite-sized horror anthology where seemingly harmless encounters, desires, and decisions take terrifying turns.

results.title: The Opera!
results.overview: The Three Chaps; Prescott, Chogurt, and Dr. Wilbert, await to see Lady Hogsmash LIVE at The Opera. While appreciating some lobby art, a horrific travesty unfolds, leaving The Chaps to wonder if they'll make it out of The Opera House on a high note.

results.title: The Brainstorm
results.overview: Rosalie tries to make a film, while her roommate and her actors keep getting in her way.

results.title: Procrastinator!!!
results.overview: A light-hearted, comedic story about a college student scrambling to finish an essay at the absolute last minute.

results.title: Sally
results.overview: Shortly before her first major stage performance, Sally realizes just how ruthless the music industry can be. She comes under increasing pressure, caught between her manager's expectations and the strains of her personal life.

results.title: Only in Death: 40,000 Ways to Die
results.original_title: Only in Death: 40,000 Ways to Die
results.overview: It might sound great to be a genetically enhanced superhuman killing machine, but the life of a Space Marine is far from sunshine and roses.

results.title: Sumaa the Flower
results.overview: Sumaa the Flower is a 2026 Kannada film.

results.title: Hamrammr
results.overview: Set in Viking Age Iceland, Hamrammr is a short historical film about grief, revenge, and the consequences of blood feud. Following the death of his wife, Egil sets out to confront the man responsible. As grief and anger take hold, the boundaries between the living and the dead begin to blur.

results.title: Inside the mind of Karl Ove Knausgård
results.original_title: Inside the mind of Karl Ove Knausgård
results.overview: BBC Documentary about the most famous Norwegian writer, Karl Ove Knausgård, author of My Struggle.

results.title: The Wealth
results.overview: In an Anatolian city, Mr. Mehmet, a wealthy and respected merchant, is approaching death. As his condition worsens, family members and acquaintances begin gathering around him. Beneath the quiet atmosphere of the house, long buried tensions, unspoken expectations, and hidden ambitions slowly emerge. Through silences, gestures, and fragile relationships, The Wealth explores the emotional and moral fractures created by inheritance, family ties, and the inevitability of death.
